title: StockSmart Statement of Program Charges — Minimum Fee, Storeroom, Bin, Visit, Change and Exit Fees
content:
## Charges of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program

**1. Monthly minimum.** Program spend is measured on the tier's measurement basis. A monthly minimum fee of the tier's monthly minimum fee is charged for a calendar month whose program spend is below the tier's minimum monthly program spend; where the tier prorates paused days, both the minimum and the fee are prorated by the share of the month's calendar days the program was not paused, rounded half up to the cent, and a month paused throughout carries no fee. A month's program spend is the total of the replenishment billed on replenishment invoices dated in the month and the consumption billed for the month; fees, freight and buyback are excluded. On every tier the minimum and the fee are that tier's own two figures.

**2. Storeroom management.** The Onsite Storeroom tier is charged its onsite management fee every month, prorated the same way for paused days.

**3. Additional bins.** Bins above the tier's included bins at month end are charged the tier's additional bin fee each for that month. The bins counted are the distinct bin labels whose latest bin entry on the last day of the billing month sets the bin rather than removes it.

**4. One monthly fee of each type.** Each monthly fee type is charged at most once per program per billing month.

**5. Visit charges.** An emergency visit beyond the tier's included emergency visits in the calendar quarter carries the tier's emergency visit fee; the count is of the emergency visits completed in the quarter of the visit, up to and including the visit being charged, in date then reference order. A scheduled visit the customer cancels with less than the tier's cancellation notice hours of notice, or refuses at the gate, carries the tier's trip charge.

**6. Bin and par changes.** A new bin beyond the tier's included bin adds and a par change beyond the tier's included par changes in the calendar month carry the tier's bin add fee and par change fee respectively; the count is of the bin entries of the kind being charged (new bin or par change) effective in the month, up to and including the one being charged, in date then reference order. A bin or label replaced because of customer damage carries the tier's bin replacement fee.

**7. Early exit.** A program closing before the tier's minimum term in calendar months after its go-live date carries the tier's early exit fee once; a fee whose tier amount is 0.00 is never charged.

### Proration — hypothetical example

A hypothetical program on a tier with a 2000.00 minimum and a 150.00 fee is paused for 6 days of a 30-day month. It was not paused for 24 of 30 days, a share of 0.8: the minimum becomes 1600.00 and the fee 120.00. Program spend of 1500.00 that month is below 1600.00, so 120.00 is charged; program spend of 1700.00 is not, so no minimum fee is charged.

### Additional bins — hypothetical example

At month end a hypothetical program has 210 bins against 200 included and a 0.75 fee per additional bin: 10 bins above the allowance carry 7.50 for the month.
